operator_guide.unit_conversion: Raw mmol/L-per-BMI coefficient times 5*38.67; coefficient on scaled BMI times 38.67. This numerical unit conversion is not an assay calibration.
operator_guide.rank_bridge: 2*sin(pi*Spearman/6) is a latent Pearson correlation only under a continuous Gaussian copula. Neither quantity equals a raw adjusted projection endpoint.
operator_guide.dispersion: Source marginal individual SD, conditional innovation SD, final projection residual SD, Monte Carlo variability and parameter uncertainty are different quantities.
operator_guide.claim_interpretation: Exact-law values are analytic consequences of assumed fixed laws. Recipe-only means an appropriate expression is available, not that a scalar was validated. Unavailable is not zero.
operator_guide.components: HDL/non-HDL independence yields positive TC/HDL correlation when TC=HDL+non-HDL. Noncomponent copulas can produce HDL>TC without violating the frozen output schema.
